summary: runner._synthesize heuristic replaced by one structured OpenClaw provider call (invoke_structured_extraction) under the existing InteractionLifecycleStore durable invocation claim (persona_id 'synthesis'). Wire projection matches the committed InteractionSynthesis schema (string agreements, {opinion_ids,cause,detail} disagreements, unavailable = status 'degraded'); the saved result rides the invocation row and is stripped from provider_invocations reads so ProviderInvocation stays schema-valid.

review_fixes.crash_window: adapter does not dedupe on Idempotency-Key, so a reclaimed claim (claim attempt > 1) is NOT re-executed: it is recorded as failed SYNTHESIS_OUTCOME_AMBIGUOUS (synthesis degraded) and only an operator-requested retry (new attempt) calls the provider again
review_fixes.set_identity: opinions are sorted by opinion_id before hashing, so reordered saved sets share one synthesis id and adopt the saved result
review_fixes.schema: InteractionSynthesis and ProviderInvocation (incl. synthesis entry) validated with jsonschema for success and failure
review_fixes.unsupported_schema_keyword: removed uniqueItems from transmitted _IDS (adapter _SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS lacks it; nonempty disagreements previously 422'd OPENCLAW_TOOL_ARGS_SCHEMA_MISMATCH); uniqueness still enforced locally in _validated_synthesis via len(set(opinion_ids))>=2. Regression test_synthesis_schema_accepted_by_real_adapter_validator runs actual adapter _validate_extraction_arguments with nonempty disagreements (fails with uniqueItems restored, passes now).

validation.membership_checks: nested shapes enforced; disagreement opinion_ids >=2 and subset of supplied opinions; evidence_refs subset of supplied opinion evidence
validation.failure_mode: provider/malformed/ambiguous -> synthesis status degraded 'Synthesis unavailable.', opinions preserved, retryable by operator; personas are not re-invoked
